docs.title: Operations runbook
docs.text: The service restarts automatically after a failed health check. The orchestrator waits 30 seconds before the second attempt.

docs.title: Kebijakan cadangan
docs.text: Cadangan basis data dibuat setiap hari pukul 02.00 WIB dan disimpan selama 30 hari di penyimpanan terpisah.

docs.title: Employee onboarding
docs.text: New employees receive a laptop and accounts on their first day. Security training must be completed within the first week.

docs.title: Kebijakan cuti
docs.text: Karyawan tetap berhak atas 12 hari cuti tahunan. Pengajuan cuti dilakukan melalui atasan langsung paling lambat tiga hari sebelumnya.

docs.title: API rate limits
docs.text: Each API key may send 600 requests per minute. Requests above the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header.

docs.title: Prosedur rilis
docs.text: Rilis produksi dilakukan hari Selasa dan Kamis. Setiap rilis wajib melewati tinjauan kode dan uji regresi otomatis.

docs.title: Data retention (2024)
docs.text: Audit logs are retained for 90 days and then deleted permanently.

docs.title: Retensi data (2026)
docs.text: Log audit disimpan selama 365 hari sebelum dihapus permanen.

docs.title: On-call rotation
docs.text: The on-call engineer rotates every Monday at 09:00. The primary acknowledges pages within 15 minutes.

docs.title: Support SLA (standard)
docs.text: Standard plan customers receive a first response within 24 hours.

docs.title: SLA dukungan (prioritas)
docs.text: Pelanggan paket standar mendapat respons pertama dalam 8 jam kerja.
